dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL (likely Personal COBOL or Net Express) indicated by $SET directive, COMP-X, COMP-5, CRT STATUS, CURSOR IS, SCREEN SECTION with FOREGROUND-COLOR/BACKGROUND-COLOR, and CONSOLE IS CRT. Author J W Lemmon (APAC) with GPL license. Version 8.15.00 November 2010.

purpose.domain_detail: Print/spool/display utility subprogram for a business application suite (APAC system by J W Lemmon). Supports printer output, spooling to disk, and screen display of reports.
purpose.summary: PRINTUTL is a callable subprogram that provides unified print/spool/display services for reports. It handles opening/closing printers and spool files, printing lines with paper advance control, spooling lines, and displaying report output on screen with left/right scrolling. Calling programs treat all output as printer output and are unaware of the actual destination.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with color attributes (FOREGROUND-COLOR, BACKGROUND-COLOR)
CRT STATUS and CURSOR IS special-names
LINAGE clause on FD for page control
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple 01 parameters (CHAIN.LS, LS-SCREEN-PRINT, L02-PRINTER-DETAILS)
Box-drawing characters (IBM PC line-draw) in VALUE literals
OCCURS clauses for screen line arrays
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full procedure division not visible. Fixed format with sequence numbers in columns 1-6 on some lines but tab-indented on others — mixed numbering style typical of Micro Focus tools. GPL-licensed personal software by James William Lemmon, version 8.15.00 (2010). The APAC copybook references suggest a larger integrated business application suite.
